scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained. The accompanying finite numerical tests corroborate rather than establish the universal theorem. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact spherical harmonic degree two only; two equal-size mirror-height latitude rings with equally weighted samples.
Optimality is among this two-ring family, not among arbitrary spherical arrays, and the theorem does not cover full low-pass spaces.
Earlier specialized array-design literature may contain an equivalent formula; literature comparison is bounded.
title: Sharp quadrupole conditioning on paired spherical latitude rings
